observations.body: Mercy, hardening, potter, and prophetic witnesses. What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be! As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

payload.posture: Read Romans 9:14–29 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states mercy, hardening, potter, and prophetic witnesses. What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be! As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
